content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-53. - Rejection of bids; waiver of irregularities.
content.summary:
The city shall have the right to reject any and all bids and to waive any irregularity
               in any bid.
(Code 1981, § 27-54; Ord. No. 551, § 19(E), 5-14-1964)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 31-25-516.
